title: Ultrean Food Scale, Digital Kitchen Scale with LCD Display, Weight Grams and Ounces for Baking Cooking and Meal Prep, 6 Units with Tare Function, 304 Stainless Steel, 11lb (Batteries Included)

reviews.body: Perfect for our needs. I cook a lot but many recipes call for grams and other measurements I don’t have a clue about. This makes it easy. It’s small and easy to store (we tuck it in a cabinet on its side). It’s very accurate and I use it almost daily...

It’s small but very light! The button responsiveness is great. Very accurate so far and the color is very nice because make it look clean and professional. Versatile and looks like it will last me a while in terms of durability. 10/10 if you are look...
